info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Economic Capital Model Retrieval API allows users to access specific economic capital model data by providing a parameter. This endpoint serves financial analysts and risk managers who require detailed insights into economic capital models for assessment and reporting purposes. By retrieving model information based on a unique identifier, users can make informed decisions related to risk management and financial strategy. Typical use cases include performance analysis and regulatory compliance documentation.

get.summary: Retrieve Economic Capital Model by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific Economic Capital model identified by its unique ID. Use this to obtain essential information and attributes related to the model, facilitating further analysis or reporting.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve data regarding the economic capital model identified by RES-100045. It specifies parameters for filtering or customizing the response data, allowing users to tailor the query results to their needs.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource data has been returned.

GetModelByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to economic capital. The expected input is a string.

modelId.description: The unique identifier for the economic capital model.

modelVersion.description: The version of the economic capital model.

portfolioId.description: The identifier for the portfolio associated with the model.

asOfDate.description: The date as of which the model data is relevant.

scenario.description: The scenario under which the model is evaluated.

confidenceLevel.description: The confidence level of the model results, expressed as a decimal.

version.description: The version number of the response.
